analysis:
The PR change to ProviderLoop.swift is small and purely additive state. At head lines 705-716 it adds selectedModelRecovery (SelectedModelRecovery), selectedModelRecoveryLoadOverride (a test-only seam, nil in production), savedEnabledModels and enabledModelsAtLastSwitch. At head line 868 it adds the init assignment savedEnabledModels = config.config.backend.enabledModels. The new stored properties contain no logic, no I/O, no network or crypto calls, no key material, and no changes to attestation, App Attest, authorization or encryption paths.

The model-selection state is non-sensitive configuration (model IDs). The recovery logic itself (ProviderLoop+SelectedModelRecovery) is not supplied here. Open questions for integration: (1) Does the recovery load path bypass the advertised-set guard, the weight-hash self-test, or the memory-admission checks that normal ensureModelLoaded applies (T-027, T-012)? (2) Does the override seam stay out of production, and does recovery respect the draining, update and shutdown gates and the retiringModels / failedSelfTestHashes tombstones (the ABA concern)? (3) Does recovery honor App Attest serving authorization and the connection-generation barriers (T-053)? (4) Does the savedEnabledModels refresh read the config file without permitting a consumer or coordinator to influence the selection? None of these can be assessed from the supplied diff, so no finding is raised. The remaining unchanged parts of the file were read as context only; they show no regression tied to this diff.
